page.overview:
What is Battle of the Angor system?

The Battle of the Angor system occurred shortly before the start of the Yuuzhan Vong War. In the battle, the Dozen and Two Avengers under Jedi Knight Kyp Durron attacked smugglers in the Outer Rim Territories' Angor system. It was believed by the New Jedi Order that the smugglers had ties to Senator Fyor Rodan of the New Republic, as he used the battle as one of the excuses against giving further benefits to the Jedi.
